title: Power bank, battery cells from China, circuit board and case from Vietnam
description: A 4,000 mAh power bank. The circuit board and the plastic case come from Vietnam; the two lithium-ion cells come from China, where the bank is assembled. CBP held China (N352355).
notes: One of the families added in D138 (power supplies and chargers). Built from the D171 fixture for CBP ruling N352355 (dev split, never a test split): the product was drafted by gemini-4-argon from CBP's facts and reviewed by hand; the target plant's capabilities, duty rates, import value and group costs are illustrative placeholders, not sourced. Precedents are limited to rulings dated before 2025-09-03, and N352355 itself is excluded. Picked by family, not by result (D191): the first D171 fixture of each of four families. Recorded result (eval/results/planner-families-n352355-litellm.json): the engine said China at 0.95 stated, where CBP held China (it agrees with CBP). First plan shown: "Move the power conversion or charging module to Vietnam" (in this product: Two cylindrical lithium-ion battery cells), check 0.96 on N352014. That ruling, read by hand: supports (N352014 (power bank) holds origin by where the battery cells are made.) A run on this site is a new run and may differ.

product.name: Deal Worthy 4,000 mAh power bank, model number PB41
product.description: A portable battery for charging electronic devices with a nominal capacity of 4,000 mAh and a nominal energy of 14.8 Wh. It consists of two cylindrical lithium-ion battery cells and a printed circuit board assembly enclosed in an injection molded plastic case with a plastic button, light guide, light shield, USB-A output connector, and micro-USB input connector, packaged with a charging cable.

components.name: Printed circuit board assembly (with a USB-A and a micro-USB connector)
Injection molded case (bottom and top cases)

operations.name: Solder wires to the printed circuit board assembly
Weld a nickel strip to two battery cells
Weld the wires from the printed circuit board assembly to the battery cells
Place the PCBA and battery cell assembly inside the bottom case with a pre-installed button, light guide, and light shield
Test, inspect, and package the device with the charging cable
